sources.quote: HONORARIUMS TO BIBLE WORKERS, MUSICIANS, SPEAKERS: All payments for services to a single individual or company of $600.00 or more within a calendar year is required to be reported to the IRS. If you intended to pay for services that will require reporting to the IRS these needs to be dispersed through the Human Resources Department of the Northern New England Conference.

notes: Two versions are online: the Jan 2024 Subsidy Request Form + guidelines (Evangelism page) and the older 2022 'Evangelism Financial Planning' packet (Treasury page) with the lead-time percentages, 15-meeting minimum and 90/10 payments; ask the Evangelism Director which still applies. The form's mailing address (479 Main St, Westbrook) differs from the office address now on the site (91 Allen Ave, Portland, ME) — e-mail is safer. Churches led by volunteer lay pastors/leaders apply through their supervising pastor by 30 October of the year before. Union level (Atlantic Union): the union's 2025–2030 Strategic Plan promises 'annual additional funding to each conference, designated for evangelism' but publishes no amounts or application process, so any union money reaches churches through the conference. In 2025 the union matched the NAD's Pentecost 2025 grant (NAD up to $3,000 per proclamation initiative; 'AU-Matching Financial Contribution' line on the union form); nothing equivalent for 2026–27 (OneVoice27 / All Things New) was found on the union's sites.
